Does Brad Pitt die in Across the Tracks?

He plays Joe Maloney.

Want to guess first?

Revealing shows the answer, the scene, and a clip if we have one.

No. Runs the big race and keeps breathing.

Straight-A track star Joe is chasing a Stanford scholarship when his delinquent brother Billy (Rick Schroder) comes home from juvie and joins a rival school's team. The brothers' rivalry culminates in a head-to-head race with Joe's future on the line. It's a drama about brothers learning a lesson; nobody dies.
